name: Send message and receive response with timestamps
expected: Agent responds with relevant message, timestamps shown on both user and agent messages

name: File upload via chat
steps: Upload a small text file via the upload button
expected: File uploaded successfully, agent acknowledges receiving the file with correct workspace path

name: Multi-paragraph response renders correctly
steps: Ask agent: 'Write a response with 3 separate paragraphs'
expected: Response shows visible paragraph breaks between sections, not a wall of text

name: Rename chat session
steps: Find a chat session in the sidebar
Right-click or find the rename option
Verify the new name persists after page refresh
expected: Session renamed successfully, name persists after page refresh

name: Delete chat session
steps: Find a chat session in the sidebar
Refresh page and verify it's still gone
expected: Session deleted, removed from sidebar, deletion persists after refresh

name: Page refresh preserves session and messages
steps: Note the current session and last few messages
Verify same session loads with messages intact
expected: Same chat session loads after refresh, all messages preserved

name: Switch agents → last conversation resumes
steps: Chat with Agent A, note the conversation
Verify the previous conversation with Agent A resumes
expected: Switching back to Agent A shows the last conversation, not a new/empty chat

name: Emoji reactions on messages
steps: Refresh page and verify reaction persists
expected: Emoji reaction added to message, badge shows, persists after refresh

name: Model picker shows gateway default
steps: Verify it shows the gateway default model (not a hardcoded value)
expected: Model picker displays the gateway's configured default model

name: Rapid agent switching — no ghost sessions
expected: No ghost or duplicate sessions appear in sidebar from rapid switching
